description:
Adds one task to an existing project and recalculates the dates. Position: parentTask (as a subtask), afterTask or beforeTask (among siblings); with none of them it goes to the end of the top level. If the parent had no subtasks it becomes a summary task whose dates come from its subtasks.
Duration is in working days; a milestone has zero duration. Calling it twice adds two tasks. Requires write permission.

deadline.description: Task deadline in ISO 8601 with offset, e.g. 2026-11-30T17:00:00Z.

durationDays.description: Duration in working days. Default 1 day.

durationMinutes.description: Duration in working minutes. Takes precedence over durationDays.

parentTask.description: Insert as a subtask of this task (at any level).

projectId.description: Project id (uuid), as returned by planitude_list_projects.

type.description: 'task' (default), 'milestone' (zero duration) or 'summary' (dates come from its subtasks).

name: planitude_add_task
title: Add task
